categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in MEMS (Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems) chip process development and wafer manufacturing, semiconductor equipment sales, and navigation product R&D, production, and sales. It also engages in related software and hardware product agency sales and technical development services. The MEMS business includes process development and wafer manufacturing, serving diverse applications such as communication computing, biomedical, industrial automotive, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced MEMS manufacturing technologies including silicon through-via (TSV), glass through-via (TGV), wafer bonding, deep reactive ion etching (DRIE), and advanced lithography (DUV). It integrates microfabrication techniques with materials like piezoelectric, polymer, and magnetic materials. The production involves standardized process modules ('SmartBlock'), combining photolithography, bonding, oxidation annealing, deposition, dry and wet etching, measurement, and wafer dicing, emphasizing precision and customization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leaders and innovative startups in sectors such as silicon photonics, lidar, motion capture, photolithography, DNA/RNA sequencing, high-frequency communication, AI computing, ICT, infrared thermal imaging, computer networks, social networks, and new medical devices. The end markets span communication computing, biomedical, industrial automotive, and consumer electronics, with a strong presence in both mature enterprises and emerging companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major manufacturing facilities in Sweden and China (Beijing). Revenue distribution includes approximately 40.7% from domestic China, 35.4% from North America, 22% from Europe, and smaller shares from Asia, Middle East, and Oceania. It maintains a dual-cycle operational model with production and R&D capabilities both domestically and internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a pure MEMS foundry, focusing on process development and wafer manufacturing. It is expanding downstream into advanced packaging and testing services, aiming to provide integrated one-stop services from process development through manufacturing to packaging and testing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous R&D investment to enhance MEMS process technologies, develop new MEMS products (e.g., silicon microphones, BAW filters, inertial sensors, gas sensors, biochips, silicon photonics), and expand production capacity. The company emphasizes innovation in AI, data centers, optical transmission, high-frequency communication, biomedical, automotive, and industrial applications. It also focuses on building integrated R&D and manufacturing platforms, fostering talent, and strengthening domestic and international market presence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through MEMS process development fees (NRE) and wafer manufacturing services (foundry). Additional revenue comes from semiconductor equipment sales, primarily sourced from strategic overseas procurement and sales to both internal fabs and external semiconductor manufacturers. The company operates on a direct sales model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in pure MEMS foundry services, with its Swedish subsidiary Silex consistently ranked among the top five globally and first among pure MEMS foundries. Competitors include IDM companies like Bosch, HP, STMicroelectronics, Texas Instruments, and foundries such as Teledyne, TSMC, X-FAB, Sony, and domestic players like Chiplink, Guangzhou Zengxin, Shanghai Advanced, Huahong Hongli, China Resources Microelectronics, and Silan Microelectronics. The company maintains a leading position through advanced technology and global dual-cycle operations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.2 billion, a 7.31% decrease from the previous year, with net profit turning negative at around RMB -170 million attributable to shareholders. The MEMS business grew by 16.63%, driven by wafer manufacturing growth of 31.52%, while semiconductor equipment sales declined by 60.37%. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D (R&D expenses accounted for 37.75% of revenue in 2024) and capacity expansion, with total assets around RMB 7 billion and equity attributable to shareholders about RMB 4.9 billion. Cash flow from operations improved significantly by 146.27%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers globally leading MEMS foundry services with comprehensive process technology coverage and mature core technologies validated by years of production. It emphasizes high customization, precision manufacturing, and cost control through standardized process modules and extensive project experience. Its dual-cycle domestic and international production system enhances supply security and customer responsiveness. The company is expanding into integrated packaging and testing services, aiming to provide end-to-end solutions. Strong R&D capabilities, a large patent portfolio, and a highly skilled workforce underpin its competitive advantage.
